item.rpgrealms.vallsaron_scale.lore: Armor of the deep, it glows when the tide rises.
item.rpgrealms.vallsaron_fin.lore: It still ripples as if it were swimming.
item.rpgrealms.vallsaron_tooth.lore: It only bit to defend what it loved.
item.rpgrealms.vallsaron_eye.lore: It watched the abyss for a thousand years.
item.rpgrealms.vallsaron_heart.lore: It still beats, slow as the ocean.
effect.rpgrealms.vallsaron_blessing.desc: Breathe, swim fast and see in the deep. The tide itself protects you.
